Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Jitendra Kumar, Adv.
 For the State : Mr. Ashok Kumar Singh, App
 For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. Amit Kumar Singh, Adv.
 Mr. Dhurendra Kumar, Adv.
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Harish Kumar
 Oral Order

Heard learned Advocate for the petitioner, learned APP for the State and learned Advocate for the O.P. No.2.
2.

Though, the learned Sessions Judge, East Champaran, Motihari having noticed the fact that the case has been instituted with respect to an offence under Section 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code,
disposed off the same in terms with the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar [(2014) 8 SCC 273] and Satyendra Kumar Antil v. Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr. [S.L.P. (Cri) No.5191 of 2021]; however, learned Advocate for the respective parties have submitted that Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.61612 of 2025(4) dt.03-12-2025 still there is a chance of settlement between the parties as the dispute arose on account of matrimonial discord, let the matter be referred to the Patna High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre,
where both the parties shall ensure their appearance on 15.12.2025 at 11:00 o'clock along with the order of this Court.
